about.title: About NDS-Shop
about.description: NDS-Shop is your go-to platform for Nintendo DS games, regularly updated with new releases and easy-to-access downloads.
about.discord_section_desc: Chat with the team and community, follow new releases, and share your ideas.
about.project_description: NDS-Shop is an open-source project developed by a community of video game enthusiasts. Our goal is to provide a user-friendly and accessible platform for Nintendo DS fans, offering a wide selection of games for easy downloading. We believe in the power of community and encourage contributions to continuously improve the site and expand our game catalog.

docs.title: API Documentation
docs.description: The public NDS-Shop API gives you access to the game catalog, statistics, and metadata. All routes return JSON.
docs.route_health: Checks whether the API is online.
docs.route_games: Lists all games in the catalog.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Simple, clear, and transparent for NDS-Shop
privacy.dataCollectionText: NDS-Shop is a Nintendo DS game, homebrew, and forwarder download site. We do not create accounts, require no registration, and collect no personal data from our visitors.
dataCollectionItems: No sign-up or account needed to download
No data is sold or shared with third parties
The site works anonymously: we do not know who downloads what
privacy.technicalText: Like any website, your browser exchanges limited technical information to display pages and download files:
technicalItems: IP address and browser (only for network routing and security)
Basic server logs, automatically cleaned after a few days
Temporary cache files managed by your browser
Downloaded files are never tracked or linked to a user
privacy.thirdPartyText: NDS-Shop relies on third-party services only to host and distribute the site and its files:
thirdPartyItems: Web hosting and game file storage
GitHub hosting for source code and app releases
These services may see standard request logs, but no user personal data
privacy.securityText: Although we do not collect data, we maintain a secure infrastructure:
securityItems: No sensitive data stored — nothing to steal
privacy.contactText: For any question about privacy or how the site works, contact us:
privacy.updatesText: This policy may be updated if the site evolves. Changes will be posted on this page. Last updated: August 2026

compliance.title: 1. Compliance
compliance.content: NDS-Shop lists Nintendo DS games, homebrew, and forwarders from public sources and community contributions. We respect intellectual property rights and handle each removal request individually.
compliance.important: Important: if you are a rights holder and want content removed, contact us — we will process your request quickly.

notification.title: 2. Notification Requirements
notification.description: To request content removal, please provide:
items: Identification of the content (game title, exact link)
A statement that you are the rights holder or authorized to act on their behalf
The reason for the removal request

counter.title: 3. Counter-Notification
counter.description: If you believe content was removed by mistake:
items: An explanation of why the removal is an error
Any proof of your rights to the content

filing.title: 4. Filing a Request
filing.content2: We usually respond within 48 to 72 hours.
filing.content3: Abusive or unfounded requests may be ignored.

repeat.title: 5. Repeat Infringers
repeat.content: We may restrict access to content repeatedly flagged as infringing copyright.
